meta.title: Carolo Canis — dog training, Karlovac
meta.description: Individual dog training, equipment and food, and cynology advice. Carolo Canis Ltd., Karlovac. Owner Marinko Alić, court expert in cynology.

hero.lede: A small, tightly focused firm. We work with the owner and the dog — one at a time — and have done so for more than twenty years.
hero.statLabel: years working with owner and dog

training.title: Dog training
training.body: Courses with owners, strictly one-to-one. No two dogs are the same, and neither are their owners’ aims — so we dropped group classes long ago.

shop.title: Equipment and food
shop.body: A shop for dog equipment and food. Advice on what to buy comes from the field, not from a catalogue.

advice.title: Advice and expert work
advice.body: Cynology advice grounded in the owner’s credentials: court expert in cynology, and a working-dog judge.

about.title: About us
about.p1: Many enter the world of cynology unprepared, curious and sincere — and problems can catch them on the first steps, some of them growing too large with time. Twenty years of practice give us the freedom to make the path easier, faster and better.
about.p2: These pages are a place to meet us, settle basic issues with your own dog, and — if cynology becomes more than a pastime — to enjoy it.
about.p3: Carolo Canis Ltd. is a small, tightly profiled company in cynology: dog training, equipment and food, and advice that follows from the owner’s professional authority.

method.title: How we work
method.intro: The work is built around courses with dog owners. Everyone is trained individually.

individual.title: Individual only
individual.body: We no longer run group courses. Every dog and every owner brings a different set of demands.

open.title: Open time slot
open.body: Once a week, in an agreed window. You are not tied to a precise minute — arrive when it suits you. First come, first trained, unless a session was booked ahead.

exam.title: Training exam
exam.body: After the course we recommend a proficiency exam — proof of the work invested, and a sign to others that you keep a trained, well-mannered dog. We can help at several levels.

pay.title: Pay as you progress
pay.body: In instalments, according to the level reached. Nothing in advance. Missed sessions for the dog’s illness or your own inability to attend are not charged. Prices are agreed in direct contact, according to the owner’s aims.

locations.title: Training locations
locations.intro: We run sessions in a few cities. Exact addresses and times will be listed here shortly.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: For a course, equipment or advice — write or call directly.
